class.name: VideoPreset
class.brief_description: A graphics preset: a name and the values it sets in the four video settings domains.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all values of all domains. The name stays.

method.name: erase_value
method.description: Removes the value [param name] of the domain [param domain] from the preset: applying the preset no longer changes it.

method.name: get_domain_values
method.description: Returns the values of the domain [param domain] (one of [method get_domains]): setting name to value. Prints an error and returns an empty [Dictionary] for another domain.

method.name: get_domains
method.description: Returns the settings domains a preset covers, in the order [method VideoPresetSettingsServer.apply_preset] applies them: [code]["video_quality", "video_texture", "video_shadow", "video_effect"][/code].

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value [param name] of the domain [param domain], or [param default] if the preset doesn't set it.

method.name: has_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the preset sets the value [param name] of the domain [param domain].

method.name: set_domain_values
method.description: Replaces the values of the domain [param domain] (one of [method get_domains]) with [param values]: setting name to value.

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the value [param name] of the domain [param domain] (one of [method get_domains]) to [param value]. The key is stored as a [String].

members.member: The name of the preset, for example [code]"High"[/code]. [VideoPresetSettingsServer] finds presets by this name and stores it as the player's choice. It can't be empty or [code]"Custom"[/code] (see [method VideoPresetSettingsServer.get_custom_preset_name]). Translate it in the user interface with [method Object.tr].
The values of the domain [code]"video_effect"[/code] ([VideoEffectSettings]): setting name to value, for example [code]{ "ssao_quality": 2, "allow_ssr": true }[/code].
The values of the domain [code]"video_quality"[/code] ([VideoQualitySettings]): setting name to value, for example [code]{ "msaa_3d": 1, "scaling_3d_scale": 1.0 }[/code].
The values of the domain [code]"video_shadow"[/code] ([VideoShadowSettings]): setting name to value, for example [code]{ "directional_shadow_atlas_size": 4096 }[/code].
The values of the domain [code]"video_texture"[/code] ([VideoTextureSettings]): setting name to value, for example [code]{ "anisotropic_filtering_level": 3 }[/code].
